No, the employer probably cannot enforce the covenant in most U.S. jurisdictions. A covenant signed mid-employment needs new consideration, and continued at-will employment is illusory because the employer could have fired her at any time, so keeping her on is not a real benefit it bargained away. Some states, such as Illinois, accept continued employment as consideration after a substantial period, so the outcome depends on the governing law and on whether she received something new, like a raise or promotion.
